panel.title: Unusual Port Activity (High ports, rare access)

search.query: `pfsense_index` sourcetype=pfsense:filterlog | eval rule_origin_norm=coalesce(rule_origin,"unknown") | eval rule_origin_tok=if("$rule_origin$"="" OR "$rule_origin$"="*", "*", "$rule_origin$") | where rule_origin_tok="*" OR rule_origin_norm=rule_origin_tok | eval action_norm=lower(coalesce(action,vendor_action)), direction_norm=lower(coalesce(direction,vendor_direction)), transport_norm=lower(coalesce(transport,vendor_transport)), src_ip_norm=coalesce(src_ip,src), dest_ip_norm=coalesce(dest_ip,dest), dest_port_norm=coalesce(dest_port,dport), app_norm=lower(coalesce(app,application,app_proto)), bytes_norm=coalesce(bytes, bytes_in), src_host_norm=coalesce(src_host,""), dest_host_norm=coalesce(dest_host,""), src_display=coalesce(src_host, src_ip_norm), dest_display=coalesce(dest_host, dest_ip_norm) | where dest_port_norm>1024 AND dest_port_norm<65535 | stats count by dest_port_norm, dest_display | where count<5 | sort - count | head 20

`pfsense_index` sourcetype=pfsense:filterlog | eval rule_origin_norm=coalesce(rule_origin,"unknown") | eval rule_origin_tok=if("$rule_origin$"="" OR "$rule_origin$"="*", "*", "$rule_origin$") | where rule_origin_tok="*" OR rule_origin_norm=rule_origin_tok | eval action_norm=lower(coalesce(action,vendor_action)), direction_norm=lower(coalesce(direction,vendor_direction)), transport_norm=lower(coalesce(transport,vendor_transport)), src_ip_norm=coalesce(src_ip,src), dest_ip_norm=coalesce(dest_ip,dest), dest_port_norm=coalesce(dest_port,dport), app_norm=lower(coalesce(app,application,app_proto)), bytes_norm=coalesce(bytes, bytes_in), src_host_norm=coalesce(src_host,""), dest_host_norm=coalesce(dest_host,""), src_display=coalesce(src_host, src_ip_norm), dest_display=coalesce(dest_host, dest_ip_norm) | search action_norm="blocked" | eval direction_in=if(like(direction_norm, "in%"), 1, 0) | where direction_in=1 | stats count as attempts, dc(dest_port_norm) as ports_scanned, dc(dest_ip_norm) as targets by src_ip_norm | eval risk_score=attempts*2 + ports_scanned*5 + targets*3 | where risk_score>100 | sort - risk_score | head 20 | rename src_ip_norm as "Source IP", attempts as "Block Count", ports_scanned as "Ports Targeted", targets as "Dest IPs", risk_score as "Risk Score"

`pfsense_index` sourcetype=pfsense:filterlog | eval rule_origin_norm=coalesce(rule_origin,"unknown") | eval rule_origin_tok=if("$rule_origin$"="" OR "$rule_origin$"="*", "*", "$rule_origin$") | where rule_origin_tok="*" OR rule_origin_norm=rule_origin_tok | eval action_norm=lower(coalesce(action,vendor_action)), direction_norm=lower(coalesce(direction,vendor_direction)), transport_norm=lower(coalesce(transport,vendor_transport)), src_ip_norm=coalesce(src_ip,src), dest_ip_norm=coalesce(dest_ip,dest), dest_port_norm=coalesce(dest_port,dport), app_norm=lower(coalesce(app,application,app_proto)), bytes_norm=coalesce(bytes, bytes_in), src_host_norm=coalesce(src_host,""), dest_host_norm=coalesce(dest_host,""), src_display=coalesce(src_host, src_ip_norm), dest_display=coalesce(dest_host, dest_ip_norm) | search action_norm="blocked" | eval direction_in=if(like(direction_norm, "in%"), 1, 0) | where direction_in=1 | iplocation src_ip_norm | stats count by Country | sort - count | head 10

`pfsense_index` sourcetype=pfsense:filterlog | eval rule_origin_norm=coalesce(rule_origin,"unknown") | eval rule_origin_tok=if("$rule_origin$"="" OR "$rule_origin$"="*", "*", "$rule_origin$") | where rule_origin_tok="*" OR rule_origin_norm=rule_origin_tok | eval action_norm=lower(coalesce(action,vendor_action)), direction_norm=lower(coalesce(direction,vendor_direction)), transport_norm=lower(coalesce(transport,vendor_transport)), src_ip_norm=coalesce(src_ip,src), dest_ip_norm=coalesce(dest_ip,dest), dest_port_norm=coalesce(dest_port,dport), app_norm=lower(coalesce(app,application,app_proto)), bytes_norm=coalesce(bytes, bytes_in), src_host_norm=coalesce(src_host,""), dest_host_norm=coalesce(dest_host,""), src_display=coalesce(src_host, src_ip_norm), dest_display=coalesce(dest_host, dest_ip_norm), interface_norm=coalesce(interface, dest_int, ifname, iface, intf, vendor_interface) | search interface_norm=ovpnc* OR interface_norm=tun_* OR interface_norm=enc0 | lookup pfsense_interface_map interface as interface_norm OUTPUT description as interface_desc | eval interface_label=coalesce(interface_desc, interface_norm) | timechart span=5m count by interface_label

div.p: The GeoIP panel requires the MaxMind GeoIP database to be installed in Splunk. If you see no results, install the database using the Splunk App for Lookup File Editing or manually download the MaxMind GeoLite2 database.
